zh: 各人的重擔要互相擔當

p.src: 1  Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

en: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
u.src: 1  Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

p.src: 2  Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

en: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
u.src: 2  Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

p.src: 3  For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

en: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
u.src: 3  For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

p.src: 4  But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

en: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
u.src: 4  But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

p.src: 5  For each man will bear his own burden.

en: For each man will bear his own burden.
u.src: 5  For each man will bear his own burden.

p.src: 6  But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

en: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
u.src: 6  But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

p.src: 7  Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

en: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
u.src: 7  Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

p.src: 8  For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

en: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
u.src: 8  For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

p.src: 9  Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

en: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
u.src: 9  Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

p.src: 10  So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

en: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
u.src: 10  So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

p.src: 11  See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

en: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
u.src: 11  See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

p.src: 12  As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

en: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
u.src: 12  As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

p.src: 13  For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

en: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
u.src: 13  For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

p.src: 14  But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

en: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
u.src: 14  But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

p.src: 15  For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

en: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
u.src: 15  For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

p.src: 16  As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

en: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
u.src: 16  As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

p.src: 17  From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

en: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
u.src: 17  From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

p.src: 18  The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
u.src: 18  The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
